objective: Qualified paid acquisition within the member budget

ads-account-intake.expected_when: The routine is due and its scoped report, research or reconciliation has not been verified for the period.
ads-account-intake.acceptance: A dated sourced finding, decision or reconciliation is usable by its intended reader.
ads-account-intake.fallback: Prepare a distinct sourced creative concept, ICP objection, landing-page test or retargeting readiness assessment. Low delivery does not block preparation; compare audience size, consent, exclusions and available budget before any retargeting proposal.
ads-account-intake.recovery: Refresh source facts and continue unfinished useful work in the current eligible period.
